results.detail: Most of the summary matches the DTSX: all sources are queries on CRM tables, there are no package configurations, there are 10 business steps in a linear Success chain, and every business write is an SDK ExecuteMultiple. Four units are wrong. (a) 'חיצוניות' (external) for transfer types 1/7 is supported only by the data-flow names 'Close TI External' and 'Update CoursePartition external'. No comment, constant or annotation in any supplied DTSX labels types 1/7 as external. 0009 only has TRANSFER_TYPE_JOINING_AND_TRANSFER = 1, and nothing labels type 7. By contrast, 'פנימיות' for types 5/6 is supported by the package annotation DTSX:115790 ('העברה בין מסלולים' / 'העברה בין קופותינו'). 'סגירה' is supported by annotations DTSX:114277 and 115790 ('הסתיים'). (b) [1] 'כל הכתיבה ל-CRM נעשית ב-SDK' is literally false: every data flow also INSERTs gen_etlprocesswarningBase by direct SQL through the [CRM] connection (ALTSHULER_MSCRM). [2] itself says so. (c) [2] '[CRM] ... משמש לקריאה בלבד' is contradicted by those same INSERTs: all 8 'Insert Etl process warning' OLE DB Commands use Package.ConnectionManagers[CRM]. (d) [2] 'ה-Application Name ... הועתק מחבילה אחרת' is not proven. The connection manager GUID {9330A7FB...} is unique to 0015, and no package named BO_LeumiImportMonthly is supplied. The package may simply have been renamed. This is השערה at most.

results.detail: The order matches the 23 Success constraints (no Value or Expression attributes, LogicalAnd=True, one incoming each): config -> server -> user -> Create ETL -> Clone -> Step1 -> FT56 -> Step2 -> CP internal -> Step3 -> CP external -> Step4 -> expected -> Step5 -> Close internal -> Step6 -> Close External -> Step7 -> TI Joining -> Step8 -> CP Joining -> Step9 -> TI 53 -> Step10 -> End. The OnError handler updates gen_etlprocess (statuscode 277880001) and creates an annotation (DTSX:111193-111218), so [16] is correct. Three kinds of unit are wrong. First, the 'external' meaning: [2], [3], [5] and [8] call types 1/7 'חיצונית' based only on data-flow names. Second, [3] 'לקופות שקיבלו העברה חיצונית (תנועה 56)' gives transaction type 56 the meaning 'received an external transfer'. No file labels transaction type 56. The FT56 claims themselves say the link to the transfer is השערה. Third, [7] omits the selection condition of Close TI internal, HAVING ABS(DATEDIFF(day, min(cp.gen_actualtransferdate), ti.CreatedOn)) < 30. Internal transfers whose money arrived 30 or more day boundaries from request creation are neither closed nor set to 22, so 'העברות פנימיות שהכסף שלהן התקבל נסגרות או מקבלות סטטוס פעולה 22' overgeneralizes.
